authors_reviews.title: Great shampoo for my dogs between baths
authors_reviews.text: This dry shampoo worked really well for my two short haired dogs. The foam was easy to apply to their dry coats, massage in, and towel off without any rinsing. It has a nice fresh scent and is great for quick cleanups between baths, especially since my dogs cannot stand getting bathed.The only downside is that I wish the 6.7 ounce bottle was bigger. Still, it is easy to use and a great value for the price. Overall, I think this is a great product for keeping my dogs clean and refreshed between baths.
authors_reviews.author: Jinjer pup

authors_reviews.title: A Lifesaver for Quick Cleans and In-Between Grooming Sessions
authors_reviews.text: My dog absolutely despises bath time, and trying to get him into the tub usually results in a soaked bathroom floor and a very stressed-out pup. While he still needs a traditional wash when he gets completely caked in mud, I needed something much easier for regular upkeep, especially after long walks through the woods where he might pick up pests. This waterless foam shampoo seemed like the perfect compromise to keep his coat clean and protected without the drama of a full bath.The foam dispenser bottle works really well, pumping out a rich, thick lather that doesn't immediately dissolve into a watery mess on your hands. This consistency makes it incredibly easy to work deep into his fur, ensuring that the formula actually reaches his skin where fleas and ticks like to hide. A little bit of the product goes a long way, so the 200 ml bottle feels like it will last us through quite a few touch-ups before running low.Applying the shampoo is a completely stress-free process for both of us. I just massage a few pumps of the foam directly into his coat, let it sit for a minute, and then thoroughly brush him out with a standard grooming comb. There is no need for rinsing or splashing water, which keeps my dog completely relaxed throughout the whole process. He actually seems to enjoy the massage aspect of it, turning a chore into a nice bonding moment.Once the coat dries completely, which only takes about ten or fifteen minutes, his fur feels incredibly soft and looks surprisingly shiny. It doesn't leave behind any sticky residue, stiffness, or oily film, which was one of my main concerns with a leave-in product. It does a fantastic job of breaking down daily dander and lifting away loose dirt from the surface of his coat, leaving him looking like he just stepped out of a professional grooming salon.The scent is another huge plus, offering a very clean, fresh fragrance that successfully masks that classic wet-dog smell without being overwhelmingly perfume-heavy. It smells natural and pleasant, and it lingers on his coat for a few days without causing any sneezing or discomfort for either of us. It is the perfect quick fix for when company is coming over and you realize your dog smells a bit too much like the backyard.As for the flea and tick protection, it serves as a really nice extra layer of defense when used alongside his regular monthly vet-prescribed preventative. It gives me peace of mind to apply a quick layer after he has been running through tall brush or playing with other dogs at the park. However, if your dog is already dealing with a severe, active flea infestation, you will still want to rely on a heavy-duty medicated bath or oral treatment, as this gentle foam is better suited for maintenance and light prevention.Overall, this no-rinse shampoo has been a fantastic addition to our pet care routine and has saved me from countless bathroom cleanups. It is an affordable, convenient, and gentle way to keep your dog smelling great and staying comfortable between regular baths. If you have a puppy or an older dog who hates the water, or if you just want to make your weekly grooming routine a whole lot easier, this foam is definitely worth keeping in the cabinet.

authors_reviews.title: great for water phobic dogs

authors_reviews.title: Convenient, Easy-to-Use Dry Shampoo That Gets the Job Done
authors_reviews.text: I’ve been really happy with this flea and tick waterless foam shampoo. It’s incredibly convenient, especially when I don’t have time for a full bath or when I’m on the go. I’ve used it a few times between regular washes, and it does a solid job freshening up my dog’s coat but it is not a primary flea/tick treatment.The foam is easy to apply and spreads well, so you don’t need to use a ton of product. I just rub it in and towel it off, and it leaves my dog smelling clean without being overpowering. It’s also nice not having to deal with rinsing, which makes things much quicker and less stressful for both of us.It seems to help with overall coat cleanliness, and I like having it as a backup option for quick cleanups or travel. It’s simple, effective, and makes keeping your dog fresh a lot easier between regular baths.

authors_reviews.title: This waterless dog shampoo does the job it's designed for -- easily and pleasantly
authors_reviews.text: I just used this on my six-year-old long-haired German shepherd. First, as per instructions a brushed out loose hair, which I do with a sticker comb daily unless something more drastic is needed when dog is in "full bloom". Then, I applied the foam. She's an $85 pound pretty big dog, and it took lots of foam, but that didn't seem to use up much of the liquid in the bottle. Apply comes down to giving the dog a good deep massage with foam either in hand or squirted onto the dog. Needless to say, she liked this...and she definitely does not like other baths. I found it much more pleasant that giving her a regular bath. Then, as per instructions, toweled her to damp. Then, not mentioned in instructions, I used the needle brush again. She ended up looking (almost) like traditionally water bathed and smelling great. Along the way: dog seemed to like the smell, so tried a taste, and was indifferent to that. My take: I will keep getting and using this, still also water bathing her, but not so often, and with a really good way of making her look and smell good on a much more frequent basis.

authors_reviews.title: Flea and Tick Waterless Shampoo
authors_reviews.text: I ordered this for my dog Huey. He’s a 8-years-old long haired dachshund who I adopted 3 months ago.At first, I thought I would use it as a preventative. However, the product instructs to brush before applying. I started to brush and then used a flea comb. To my horror, Huey had fleas! The reason I hadn’t noticed is because we were dealing with skin issues before this. I had him on Apoquel and then moved to Cytopoint shot. So when he was scratching, I thought it was the skin issues. I bathe him every 2 weeks because he gets stinky as a dachshund is prone to. So I was shocked! I used this product right away. Although it’s a “Flea and Tick” waterless shampoo, I will not depend on just this product. I called my vet right away for a flea treatment. I’m glad I did.I applied the product on my pup and it emulsified nicely, especially since Huey has that thick long hair. Topical products are usually hard to spread on him. I use a chlorohexidine mousse for his skin issues that doesn’t spread as easily with his thick hair. So I appreciate how this is so easy to work into his hair. It smells nice as well. It’s not heavily fragranced, which I appreciate.After applying, it dries nicely. His hair looked as natural and healthy as usual. But after a couple of hours, I did comb him again and found a couple of fleas, so I was glad I got the flea treatment from my vet. That one takes 12 hours to take effect.Overall I will continue to use this just as an added support because I live in Florida and fleas are always around! This is also something I can use just to keep him smelling good between baths. So this will not be my complete flea control, but it’s something I will continue to use.
